identifiers.statement: Bootstrap release for unattended data-only nights (ct-pz32, owner decision 2026-11-17). Capture night 2026-11-17 (hosted capture run 44049858500; 1178 receipts new to the release) built in hosted run 44065807228. The model definition equals the live release's except release_gate.py (b1d4d3fa: gate-policy helper extracted, refusal message reordered), which is gate policy, not content code. Entity digests and every producer version equal the live build's, every live receipt is kept, the link rule is clean, and every group is a capture-night shape inside the data-only tripwires, which CI evaluated on the real files. The only reason the night did not approve itself is that the live release's input record predates unprofiled_inputs; this release writes them.
